public_record_title: Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet: Classical Algebra and Arithmetic LaTeX Drafts

cayley_status.available: 77 repaired/retyped Cayley slice PDFs are front-facing, 2030 pages total.
cayley_status.broad_volume_drafts: Full per-volume working drafts are preserved in the artifact ZIP, but are not promoted as clean top-level readers.
cayley_status.chunk_level_note: The artifact ZIP also preserves the sources_tex_Vol_I through sources_tex_Vol_XIII chunk trees. Those contain 242 TeX chunks and 105 separately rendered slice PDFs (2963 pages), including the targeted repaired/retyped ranges.
cayley_status.reason_for_replacement: Earlier Cayley public readers leaked literal TeX math commands; the promoted readers are limited to chunk-level PDFs that pass a raw-command text sweep.
